title: QAReport
description: The report the qa role hands to the next stage. Pass and fail counts and coverage are not in it: the runner measures them. The rules on outcome, tests_written and gaps are checked in code, not here.

summary.description: Two or three sentences: what was tested and what was left out.

frameworks.description: Test frameworks detected, for example node:test.

file.description: Path relative to the project root.

count.description: Number of tests in the file.

gaps.description: Behavior that is not tested, or what the developer must decide.

production_issues.description: Defects in production code that the tests exposed. The qa role reports them and never fixes them.
